fields.description: Global kill switch for the Order Import Service. Off by default: imports must be deliberately enabled (fail closed, INV-10).
fields.label: Imports Enabled

fields.description: The single physical warehouse (docs/STOCK-FLOW.md §1 — provisional: 1431 Yonge). SELF Sales Orders inherit this warehouse on their items.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: Set on FBA/WFS order lines as the drop-ship fulfiller (INV-7): marketplace-fulfilled rows hold no shelf stock and map to no Delivery Note. Required before FBA/WFS orders can import (fail closed).
fields.label: Marketplace Fulfillment Supplier

fields.description: Switch ③ (C2, FLOW-DECISIONS D5/D10): when ON, a recorded shipped event immediately converts its hold into a per-shipment deduction (created+submitted partial Delivery Note). OFF by default — operators convert each event manually until trusted.
fields.label: Deduct on Shipped Event

fields.description: Switch ④ (C5, FLOW-DECISIONS D9/D10): when ON, each per-shipment deduction also creates and submits the Sales Invoice in the same heartbeat. OFF by default — invoicing stays a human click until trusted.
fields.label: Auto-Invoice on Shipment

fields.description: Account that receives marketplace-collected tax on imported orders (C5, D9: taxes recorded per order). Required when an order carries tax — imports with tax fail closed without it.
fields.label: Marketplace Tax Account

fields.description: The real 'At Amazon FBA' location (C6, FLOW-DECISIONS D4): inbound transfers land here and FBA sales deduct it. Leave empty to keep FBA unmodeled.
fields.label: FBA Warehouse
